Round 3
Scope check: 6 questions asked so far

Unanswered from last round:

❓ Q5 (rerun limit): **How many reruns should one PR get before the pr-merge lane (the CI job that merges approved PRs) stops rerunning?**

Context:
- A rerun is one more pass of both AI reviews on the PR's new head SHA, the commit the PR branch points at (.work/review-reruns/interview-checklist.md:16).
- Reruns fire on every new head SHA and never block the merge; ci-status stays the only required status check (.work/review-reruns/interview-checklist.md:17).

➡️ My recommendation: **Three reruns per PR**. Three covers the usual fix-and-re-push cycle while capping review cost on a PR pushed often (verified, .work/review-reruns/interview-checklist.md:16: reruns fire on every new head SHA).

Alternatives:
- (a) No limit. Never skips a review, but a PR pushed often reruns without end.
- (b) One rerun. Cheapest, but a second fix push goes unreviewed.

---

❓ Q6 (force-push resets): **Should a force-push that keeps the same tree reset the rerun limit?**

Context:
- A rerun is one more pass of both AI reviews on the PR's new head SHA, the commit the PR branch points at (.work/review-reruns/interview-checklist.md:16).
- The rerun limit is the most reruns one PR gets before the pr-merge lane (the CI job that merges approved PRs) stops rerunning (.work/review-reruns/interview-checklist.md:18).
- A force-push can change the head SHA without changing any file (judgment).

➡️ My recommendation: **No**. A rebase-only push changes no code, so it should not spend or refill reruns (verified, .work/review-reruns/interview-checklist.md:6: a review re-runs only when the head SHA changes).

Alternatives:
- (a) Reset it. Simple to explain, but a rebase-only push spends reruns on unchanged code.

Is there something else that would change these recommendations?
pass.why: the default detail level: no Basis: line, and each reason ends with its evidence label and source
